tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction, vide its Order dated October 7, 2023, The Arbitration Tribunal has been formed and the matter is being heard by the Tribunal.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has already filed its Statement of Claims and Affidavit of its witness to the Arbitral Tribunal. The matter is at stage of cross examination of witnesses. The cross examination is still ongoing.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: In the matter of Arbitration Petition No. 89 of 2021, Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction, at its hearing held on December 07, 2022, after hearing the arguments of both the parties, reserved the matter for passing its judgement. The Hon’ble High Court pronounced its judgement on January 27, 2023 wherein it has directed that an Arbitral Tribunal of 3 (three) members be constituted. The Arbitral Tribunal has been formed and the matter is being heard by the Arbitral Tribunal.
tax_litigation.status: The Arbitral Tribunal has pronounced the Arbitration Award on January 11, 2026. Under the Award, the Arbitral Tribunal has directed the BNCMC (“Respondent”) to pay to the Company (“Claimant”), Principal amount of Rs. 61,44,17,413/- along with an Interest accrued up to the date of award, as specified therein, within 60(Sixty) days from the date of this award. In case the Respondent fails to pay the said amount within the stipulated period, the Respondent shall be liable to pay future Interest @ 11% p.a. on the awarded amount + accrued interest as on the date of award, from the date of award to the date of actual payment. The arbitration proceedings now stand concluded.
